title: Non-Archimedean Analogue of Chase's Lemma
summary: We formulate and verify a non-Archimedean analogue of Chase's lemma. Following the framework by K.\ Eda removing restriction of cardinality from analogy on direct product between countability and non-$ω_1$-measurability, we extend the non-Archimedean analogue of Chase's lemma to a non-Archimedean counterpart of the extension by K.\ Eda of the extension by M.\ Dugas and B.\ Zimmermann-Huisgen of Chase's lemma.
